original_query: select sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly from lineitem, part where p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = 'Brand#35' and p_container = 'LG PKG' and l_quantity < ( select 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) from lineitem where l_partkey = p_partkey );
rewritten_query:
SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM part AS p
JOIN lineitem AS l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN (
    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_quantity
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
) AS a ON a.l_partkey = l.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#35'
  AND p.p_container = 'LG PKG'
  AND l.l_quantity < a.avg_quantity;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The correlated scalar subquery `0.2 * avg(l_quantity)` is evaluated per candidate row against the 60M-row lineitem table. It can be replaced by a single pre-aggregated per-part average (derived table with GROUP BY or window function), which computes each part's average only once and eliminates the SubPlan executed repeatedly.
Rewrite the implicit comma join (`FROM lineitem, part WHERE ...`) as an explicit `JOIN ... ON`, improving readability and enabling cleaner join-order/predicate pushdown by the optimizer.
Keep the highly selective predicates `p_brand = 'Brand#35' AND p_container = 'LG PKG'` as early filters on part (only ~2K rows of 2M), so the lineitem side only needs rows for matching parts.

Recommended physical design to support the rewrite: index on part(p_brand, p_container, p_partkey) and a covering index on lineitem(l_partkey) INCLUDE (l_quantity, l_extendedprice), enabling indexed lookup of lineitems per selected part.
